[bold][color=#8cb8ff]Author's note[/color][/bold]
[bold]Please read the guidebook in its entirety before playing.[/bold]
Hey, this is Simon here. In [bold]good faith[/bold], this is being made available to everyone with enough playtime in the required role. Please do remember to abide by the guidebook, and also remember that [bold]good RP is co-operative[/bold].
Please try to follow the [bold]spirit[/bold] of what I have set out in this guidebook to a tee. Going against it in an egregious manner will just [color=#ff6b6b]get this feature closed and ruin the fun for everyone[/color].
Everything can be temporary. If you don't like something, [bold]we can work together[/bold] to adjust and tune the guidebook for everyone's benefit.
[bold][color=#ffcc66]You have been given a lot of faith to respond on behalf of admins. Don't ruin it.[/color][/bold]
# Fax Responder You answer faxes sent to your fax machine on behalf of the [bold]RMC14 admin team[/bold], so you are held to the highest standards.
[bold][color=#ff6b6b]Key rules[/color][/bold] - Breaking these guidelines can lose you the role, or in extreme cases, earn a server ban. - Use a [bold]dedicated character[/bold] that [italic]only[/italic] responds to faxes. It must not be used for any other role. - Use the [bold]supplied templates[/bold] in your bag. If you do not like them, open a pull request to add or change them. - You [bold]cannot[/bold] authorize ERTs or PMC deployments. Always AHELP. - [bold]Never[/bold] go out of your way to contact any role other than the one you're designed to interact with, unless the moment [bold]requires[/bold] it. - You are [bold]epiphenomenal[/bold]: you never influence the outcome or decisions of the round. - The people you are faxing are in an evolving round and their time is limited. When communicating directly, keep it short. Players aren't required to fax back.
## Your Role You are a fax [bold]responder[/bold]. Probing a little to let players know you're there is fine, but work mostly on a [bold]"Yes, therefore"[/bold] basis.
[color=#ffcc66]This is not a very active role.[/color] Don't expect to regularly fax multiple departments; that isn't your purpose.
Your goal is to [bold]enhance the roleplay of players in the round[/bold], not to force your own story onto it. Many CLs and Correspondents join with a plan for how they want to roleplay, and being commanded and bossed around will ruin people's rounds if they aren't keen or privy.
- Setting tasks or missions is fine, but [bold]check first[/bold] that the player is willing, [bold]and[/bold] keep them comparable to the [bold]Fax Ideas[/bold] on your faction's page. - Players can misread what you say (and sometimes self antag). Choose your words carefully. - If you don't know the person you're faxing, be precise and spell things out.
[bold][color=#7ee29a]Do[/color][/bold]
[bold][color=#ff6b6b]Don't[/color][/bold]
- Alert staff to anything that may need oversight, like a CO arrest or RP standard breaches. - Keep faxes professional and true to who you represent. - Use the supplied document formats, so every responder feels consistent. - Embody your faction. Quirks are fine, but you are of the faction first. - Contact admins about anything ambiguous or tangential.
- Call anyone unrelated without an [bold]exceptional[/bold] reason. (More on this on the [textlink="Weston-Yamada" link="RMCRulesFaxResponderWeYa"] and [textlink="Free Press" link="RMCRulesFaxResponderFreePress"] pages.) - Answer calls you weren't expecting. - Disrupt the round or push players to antag. - Authorize any ERT without an admin. (You need their help anyway.) - Write egregious amounts of word salad to the people you respond to. They are in a round and their time is limited.
## Access to the Role Requires [bold]75+ hours as Corporate Liaison[/bold]. You should consistently show high-quality roleplay and strong spelling, grammar and formatting.
[color=#ff6b6b][bold]Abusing the role or ignoring these rules will result in an immediate roleban. If in doubt, contact an admin.[/bold][/color]
## What Can I Do? You hold real authority, so make measured decisions. Be creative and avoid repeating the same requests, so it stays fun for everyone involved.
Play to players' RP strengths and follow the [bold]golden map[/bold]: - [bold]1.[/bold] Make contact with the related parties, or receive a fax to respond to. - [bold]2.[/bold] Establish the scenario at play. - [bold]3. Therefore[/bold], you or the player decide on an action. - [bold]4. But[/bold], that action comes with a caveat. - [bold]5. Therefore[/bold], pivot, or escalate the severity of the story / the story's blockade. - [bold]6.[/bold] ...and so on.
### In-Character Guidelines Checklist - Respond to relevant faxes addressed to your faction. - Coordinate with other responders if a message is misdirected. - Roleplay with other responders by phone or fax. - Decide whether to report suspicious (no admin needed) activity to UNMC Command, based on your faction's interests. - Assume anyone trying to betray the UNMC is [bold]not[/bold] staff-approved, and discourage it unless told otherwise. - Request and respond to status reports from your faction's personnel.
## Fax Responder Types Each available role has its own page with the faxes you can send and any extra rules for that faction. [bold]Read the page for the role you are playing.[/bold]
[bold][color=#7ee29a]Available[/color][/bold]
[bold][color=#ffcc66]Admin only[/color][/bold]

## Admin-Only Faxes These are only played by the admin team.
### UNMC High Command - You are [bold]not[/bold] a Provost representative. Avoid appeals and Marine Law unless directed, and [bold]defer[/bold] to an active Provost responder or Inspector on legal matters.
### UNMC Provost Office - Respond to properly written and formatted appeal requests. - CLF members permanently confined for allegiance [bold]cannot[/bold] be released without [bold]explicit[/bold] staff approval, and the staff member should send that fax themselves. They are usually held "until the end of the operation". - Approve or deny CO arrest orders [bold]only if no staff are online[/bold]. Always AHELP first. - Authorize transfers of marines to Colony Marshal custody for black market investigations.
### SPP / TSE / CLF - Outside staff-led events, these factions rarely (if ever) receive faxes. - Report any fax about betraying the UNMC or overt antagonism to staff via [bold]AHELP[/bold] immediately. You may keep it from other responders or CIC in character, but [bold]never[/bold] from staff. - Usually leave these faxes unanswered unless a staff-run event involving your faction is active. Check with an admin first.
